summary: Exited at t=3m, px -6.00pts, after the position chopped near -2 to -1.75 for the first three frames then broke sharply lower in one bar. The trigger was a convergence of signals rather than price alone: 15s reversion_prob_30 collapsed from ~0.98-0.99 down to 0.284 (market stopped looking mean-reverting and started trending), 15s z_se hit -2.87 (extreme dislocation), 1m lambda_hat_30 carried a persistent t=-6.5 negative slope, and an HA-against fire printed 1m before the break. Next time I'd watch for this same combination -- reversion_prob falling through ~0.5 together with a lambda t-stat beyond +-3 and an against-side fire -- as the earliest confirmable break-from-chop signature, rather than waiting on raw point loss alone.
